findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md is architecturally stale — 85 FRs with zero Source/ implementation
findings.detail: The primary domain spec describes a SQLite-backed feature-request platform. The actual Source/ implements an in-memory work item workflow engine. Zero of 85 FRs appear in Source/. Misleads all agents and reviewers.
findings.recommendation: Archive to docs/archived/. Add roadmap banner. Update enforcer to fail when Specifications/ FRs have no plan coverage.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer ignores Specifications/ and has non-deterministic plan selection
findings.detail: Enforcer only scans Plans/*/requirements.md. Specifications/*.md is ignored entirely. Plan selection uses mtime which is non-deterministic when files share the same mtime (e.g. fresh clone). False PASS result.
findings.recommendation: Add --spec-dir mode. Pin active plan in inspector.config.yml. Update dependency-linking paths.

findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer and call workItemStore directly
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md mandates no direct DB/store calls from route handlers. All three main route files import workItemStore and call store methods directly. Business logic fragmented between routes and store.
findings.recommendation: Extract Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts. Routes call service; service calls store.

findings.title: Silent catch swallows JSON parse errors in API client without log or comment
findings.detail: catch(() => ({})) silently discards parse failures. Non-JSON error bodies produce empty objects with no diagnostic information. Violates CLAUDE.md never-swallow-errors rule.
findings.recommendation: Log raw response text on parse failure, or add explicit suppression comment.

findings.title: ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions without justification comment
findings.detail: Two eslint-disable-next-line directives hide potential stale-closure bugs. No comment explains why the dependency was intentionally omitted.
findings.recommendation: Add intentional suppression comment or fix dependency array.

findings.title: dependency-linking requirements reference obsolete portal/ paths
findings.detail: Every acceptance criterion references portal/Backend/src/ and portal/Frontend/src/ — these paths do not exist. Implementation is in Source/Backend/ and Source/Frontend/.
findings.recommendation: Update all portal/ references to Source/ in the requirements file.

findings.title: Recently-added E2E pipeline config has no Verifies: traceability comment
findings.detail: Added in most recent commit. No // Verifies: comment. The pipeline config implements tiered-merge-pipeline NFR-1, NFR-2, NFR-3 requirements which are untraced.
findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: NFR-1, NFR-2, NFR-3 at top of file.

findings.title: Jest 29.7.0 — 33 HIGH CVEs in transitive dependency chain
findings.detail: Jest is 1+ major version behind. Its transitive dependency tree introduces 33 HIGH CVEs. Single npm update closes the majority.
findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update jest ts-jest ts-node @types/jest && npm audit fix --audit-level=high

findings.title: Vite 5.4.0 — fs.deny bypass, 2 HIGH CVEs
findings.detail: Vite 5.4.0 is 3+ minor versions behind. Contains fs.deny bypass that could expose server files. Closed by updating vitest (which pulls a compatible vite).
findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite vitest

findings.title: react-router-dom 6.26.0 — open redirect vulnerability
findings.detail: react-router-dom 6.26.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability. Update to 6.30.6+ required.

findings.title: Backend has 411 total transitive deps (4 direct) — high supply chain surface area
findings.detail: The backend has only 4 direct dependencies but 411 total (407 transitive). Jest is the primary amplifier. High supply chain risk — any CVE in the jest ecosystem lands in this project.
findings.recommendation: Consider migrating from jest to a leaner test runner (e.g. vitest) to reduce transitive surface area. Short-term: keep jest up to date.

findings.title: Outdated major versions: express, pino, uuid (backend) · react, react-dom (frontend)
findings.detail: express 4.18.2 → 4.22.3+, pino 8.17.0 → 10.4.0+, uuid 9.0.0 → 14.0.2+, react 18.3.1 → 19.3.0. No critical CVEs but falling further behind increases upgrade difficulty.
findings.recommendation: Plan staged upgrades. Express and React may have breaking changes; test thoroughly.

findings.title: License compliance — PASSED. No GPL/AGPL detected.
findings.detail: All direct dependencies use MIT, Apache-2.0, or BSD-3-Clause. No viral license risk detected.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Continue monitoring on major dependency updates.
